meta.title: Vietnam Travel Guide (From India) — What No One Tells You
meta.description:
Planning a Vietnam trip from India? 🇻🇳

In this video, we share what Vietnam ACTUALLY feels like beyond Instagram — including real expectations, budget, travel planning, and things most people don’t tell you.

This is not a typical itinerary video. Instead, we break down how Vietnam works so you can plan a smarter and smoother trip.

✈️ What we cover:
- Vietnam expectation vs reality
- How to choose between North, Central, South
- Real budget breakdown (flights, stay, food, activities)
- Best way to plan 7–10 day trip
- Practical tips (visa, cash, apps, weather)

💰 Realistic budget: ₹70K – ₹1.2L per person

If you’re traveling abroad for the first time from India, Vietnam is a great starting point — but only if you plan it right.
